entities.name: Query Ham1p-like protein
observations: 193 aa protein; predicted molecular mass 20.93 kDa, theoretical pI 5.11, and charge at pH 7 of -6.24.
Contains a Ham1p_like domain (PF01725.22) spanning residues 4–188 with i-Evalue 4.3e-62.
Shows 50.5–53.7% identity and approximately 97% coverage to reviewed bacterial dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases.
Likely functions as a noncanonical purine nucleoside triphosphate pyrophosphatase, but exact substrate preference is inferred from homologs.
Likely cytosolic and dimeric based on reviewed homolog annotations.

entities.name: Q8A327
observations: Reviewed Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase; 193 aa reference protein.
Annotated to EC 3.6.1.66 and Mg2+-dependent hydrolysis of dITP, ITP, and XTP to monophosphate plus diphosphate.
Annotated as a homodimer and cytosolic protein.

entities.name: Q64MG2
observations: Reviewed Bacteroides fragilis dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase with matching function, Mg2+ dependence, homodimeric state, and EC 3.6.1.66 annotation.
Shares 53.7% identity and approximately 98% coverage with the query.

entities.name: A5FH89
observations: Reviewed Flavobacterium johnsoniae dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase with matching function, Mg2+ dependence, homodimeric state, and EC 3.6.1.66 annotation.
Shares 50.5% identity and approximately 97% coverage with the query.

entities.name: Noncanonical purine triphosphate hydrolysis
observations: Representative reactions are XTP + H2O → XMP + diphosphate + H+, dITP + H2O → dIMP + diphosphate + H+, and ITP + H2O → IMP + diphosphate + H+.
Mapped to Rhea RHEA:28610, RHEA:28342, and RHEA:29399 in reviewed homolog annotations.

entities.name: Magnesium cofactor
observations: Reviewed homologs bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit for pyrophosphatase activity.

entities.name: Purine nucleoside triphosphate catabolism
observations: Reviewed homologs are annotated to purine nucleoside triphosphate catabolic process and nucleotide-pool sanitation.
